summary: Verified the Caddyfile fix for the 'black page on /' bug caused by stale cached HTML pointing at a renamed hashed bundle. Reproduced the bug exactly on the OLD Caddyfile (:8097) and confirmed it is gone on the NEW Caddyfile (:8098). Backend static-serving tests (16) all pass; Playwright E2E across /, /bybit, /hotforex, /pepperstone, reloads, no-session, mobile and overview-failure scenarios all pass with 0 pageerrors.
critical_code_review_comments: deploy/Caddyfile fix is correct: /static/* has immutable cache and no SPA fallback (so a missing bundle 404s loudly instead of being replaced by index.html), and the HTML shell has Cache-Control: no-cache so updated HTML is revalidated on every visit. Gzip/zstd preserved, /api/* proxy intact.
deploy/frontend.Dockerfile correctly COPYs deploy/Caddyfile into the final caddy:2-alpine image, so `bash update.sh` on the VPS will apply the fix on rebuild.

BotSelector is resilient: a 500 on /api/overview, aborted /api/pepper/overview, and null-field response on /api/fx/overview all keep the page rendered — the 3 cards remain visible and 'Sin respuesta del motor' badges appear. No path leaves #root empty.
Minor (not blocking): Caddy's default MIME for .js is 'text/javascript' (observed). Content-type assertion passed because both 'javascript' substring matches. No change needed.
Nice-to-have (optional): asset-manifest.json is also served under / with Cache-Control: no-cache which is fine, but it could be moved under /static for long caching — not a bug.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two local Caddy servers are running against /root/vpsbuild: :8097 uses the OLD Caddyfile (buggy, SPA fallback for /static/*), :8098 uses the NEW Caddyfile (fix). If they go down, relaunch with: `cd /root/caddytest && nohup /root/caddy run --config Caddyfile.fixed --adapter caddyfile &` (same for Caddyfile.old). The regression test file auto-skips when 8097/8098 are unreachable.

rca of the issue.bug: Users hitting https://dominio.com/ saw a black page after a frontend update; direct URLs like /bybit worked.
rca of the issue.root_cause: The OLD Caddyfile served the SPA with a single `try_files {path} /index.html` without any Cache-Control. Two consequences: (1) the browser kept reusing a stale index.html that referenced the previous build's hashed bundle (e.g., main.OLDHASH.js), and (2) when that stale bundle was requested after a deploy, Caddy's SPA fallback returned index.html with HTTP 200 and Content-Type text/html — so the browser tried to execute HTML as JS, throwing 'Unexpected token <' and leaving #root empty (black page). Direct URLs like /bybit worked because they returned the same stale HTML, but the user would only have reached /bybit if they had already loaded the fresh HTML from somewhere else (e.g., a hard refresh of that URL).
rca of the issue.reproduction: On :8097, intercepted GET / to return the real index.html with the bundle filename rewritten to main.STALEHASH.js. Captured pageerror 'Unexpected token <\'' and #root length 0. Direct GET /static/js/main.STALEHASH.js returned 200 text/html — confirming the mechanism.
rca of the issue.fix_validated: On :8098 (new Caddyfile): /static/js/main.NOEXISTE.js → 404 (not text/html). /, /bybit, /hotforex, /pepperstone, /loquesea → 200 text/html with Cache-Control: no-cache and ETag; If-None-Match returns 304. Real bundles return Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable and the correct content-types. Gzip still active. /api/* proxy and POST /api/auth/login both work. End-to-end: login, 3 reloads of /, direct nav to each bot and back, no-session load, 390x844 mobile load, and simulated overview API failures all succeed with 0 pageerrors and non-empty #root.
